idea-plugin.name: ReviewAtlas
idea-plugin.description:
ReviewAtlas lets you review an arbitrary historical Git commit (or your current uncommitted changes) in a dedicated side-panel ToolWindow.

  • Asynchronously loads the latest 30 commits, with refresh.
  • Renders changed files as a compact directory tree, collapsing single-child folders.
  • Colors and icons distinguish added / modified / deleted / moved files.
  • Shows changed Java methods with NEW / MODIFIED / DELETED status and +/- line counts.
  • Double-click opens the native IntelliJ diff; the context menu can jump to source.
